_comment: Certified KPI definitions and parameters. build_gold.py loads them into ref.kpi_definition and ref.kpi_parameter; the semantic views read only those tables, so a parameter changes here and nowhere else.

kpis.name: Straight-through rate
kpis.definition: Share of claims decided in the business date that were decided automatically (decided_by = AUTO) without an adjuster or SIU touch, by claim type and business date.
kpis.formula: stp_rate = COUNT(decided AND decided_by = 'AUTO') / COUNT(decided) GROUP BY claim_type, business_date

kpis.name: Claim cycle time
kpis.definition: Days from first notice of loss (FNOL) to the final decision (APPROVED or REJECTED), median and P90, by claim type and decision date.
kpis.formula: cycle_days = (decided_ts - fnol_ts) / 86400 per decided claim; median and P90 GROUP BY claim_type, business_date

kpis.name: Loss ratio
kpis.definition: Approved claim amount divided by earned premium, by product line and business month. Earned premium is the annual premium pro rata for the policy days in force within the month.
kpis.formula: loss_ratio = SUM(amount_approved) / SUM(premium_amount * days_in_force_in_month / 365) GROUP BY business_month
